title: Correlation between the maternal position during childbirth and obstetric outcome
summary: According to the current state of research regarding maternal positions during birth, it is assumed that there are different risks as well as advantages for the various birthing positions. The results should contribute to a new point of knowledge regarding specific factors which influence the wellbeing of the mother and child under different birthing positions.
conditions: birth, upright birthing position, supine birth position

interventions.name: All vaginal births during the periods under study Years surveyed: 10 years at the University Hospital Münster and 3.5 years at the Florence Nightingale Hospital Düsseldorf
